faqs.q: Why do garage door cables break in Des Plaines?
faqs.a: Garage door cables in Des Plaines break for several reasons. Wear and tear from daily use is common, especially in older homes like the post-war Cape Cods and ranches. Corrosion is another major factor. Homes near the Des Plaines River corridor often have damp garage slabs. This dampness can cause rust on the bottom brackets and the galvanized lift cables. Rust weakens the cables until they fray and snap. Improper tension or a misaligned door can also cause cables to wrap improperly or fray.
